procedure.guidance: The issue may involve an exception that escapes or is swallowed. Reproduce it and read the full traceback; catch only the specific exception type at the level that can actually handle it; never use a bare `except:` or silently pass; re-raise with context (`raise ... from err`) when translating errors; make sure retries or fallbacks cannot hide a real failure; test both the error path and the normal path.
